Polymer reauction technology

Innovative and accessible technology for greener, lower-cost plastic products This pioneering technology injects gas into plastics during the manufacturing process to create micro-bubbles and is licensed to customers manufacturing plastic parts. The end-product uses 15-20% less material. Recently developed ReZorce recyclable mono-material barrier packaging solutions use this technology.
